devto_title: OpenLogi: Native Local-First Logitech Configuration Utility in Rust
devto_body:
> **TL;DR:** OpenLogi communicates directly with Logitech hardware over HID++ and UVC protocols to manage device settings without cloud connectivity. It stores configuration in a single human-editable TOML file and exposes an automation CLI alongside its GPUI interface.
> **Best for:** Developers and power users running Logitech mice, keyboards, or lights who want local configuration without bloatware.
> **Repository snapshot:** ⭐ 24 808 stars · 🍴 892 forks · Rust · Apache-2.0
> **Daily picks:** [Follow GitHub Open Source on Telegram](https://t.me/GitHub_Open_Source)

## What it is

OpenLogi is a native, local-first configuration utility for Logitech mice, keyboards, and webcams, written in Rust. It serves as a direct alternative to official vendor software like Options+, utilizing direct HID++ and UVC communication to control hardware parameters. Rather than relying on background services, cloud synchronization, or telemetry, OpenLogi manages all device states locally.

## Why it matters

Power users often rely on advanced hardware features like infinite scrolling, custom button bindings, and precise DPI adjustments. However, vendor software is frequently resource-heavy, requires account logins, and often leaves Linux users entirely unsupported. OpenLogi addresses this by providing a lightweight, cross-platform interface that respects user privacy and stores everything in plain text.

## Key features

- Configure multi-step workflows, custom shortcuts, and separate tap-and-hold bindings for any button
- Switch per-application profiles automatically based on the currently focused app
- Control pointer DPI presets, report rates, and assign a Precision Mode toggle
- Manage SmartShift wheel sensitivity, modes, and scrolling force on supported mice
- Adjust Litra light brightness and color temperature or tie power states to your webcam
- Automate hardware settings using a JSON automation API and companion CLI

## Quick start

To install OpenLogi from source using Cargo, run:

```bash
cargo install openlogi
```

## Who should try it

This tool is built for developers, system administrators, and peripheral power users who want fine-grained control over their Logitech devices on macOS, Windows, or Linux without dealing with proprietary software bloat.

## Verdict

OpenLogi successfully removes the friction of managing hardware peripherals. While it is still under active development and configurations may shift, it is an indispensable tool for anyone looking to ditch vendor software.
